title: Cleophus Cooksey Jr. – December 17, 2017 Arrest and Interview Video

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Records concerning the investigation and arrest of Cleophus Cooksey Jr. Specifically:

1. All body-worn camera and in-car camera video from the response to the apartment on East Highland Avenue in Phoenix on December 17, 2017, including the arrest of Cleophus Cooksey Jr.
2. Video recordings of all police interviews with Cleophus Cooksey Jr.
3. 911 calls and radio/dispatch audio for the December 17, 2017 incident.
4. The incident/offense reports for the Phoenix homicides attributed to Cleophus Cooksey Jr. between November 27 and December 17, 2017.

Cleophus Cooksey Jr. was convicted in September 2025 and sentenced in December 2025.

Please provide video and audio in their original digital format, with audio intact, via download link or file-sharing service. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please cite the specific exemption for each item.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Luka Thriller
